description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchDefsDocumentifier class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests methods related to indexing and documentifying entities like Contacts and Accounts, ensuring correct extraction and structure of searchable data.

classes.name: SearchDefsDocumentifierTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the behavior of SearchDefsDocumentifier, focusing on field extraction and documentification of contact and account entities.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToIndex

methods.name: testDocumentifyAccount
